facts.summary: Positive preliminary Phase 1 data presented at AACR, no DLTs · Phase 1 · VIP236 in metastatic solid tumors · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Vincerx Pharma, Inc. (the “Company”) presented positive preliminary Phase 1 data for VIP236 and provided an update on pipeline progress at the American Association for Cancer Research (AACR) Annual Meeting 2024.
evidence.safety: The Q3W schedule is well tolerated with no dose-limiting toxicity (DLT) in any patients, and no patients have discontinued VIP236 due to an adverse event.
